article_notes: Retrospective laboratory-database study (Laboklin, Germany, 2018-2024) of 342 dogs PCR- and sequencing-confirmed B. canis, A. phagocytophilum PCR-negative; first positive sample per dog, before imidocarb. No clinical outcome (survival, complications) was analysed even though questionnaires collected outcome. The only severity measure is the authors' haematological score (HES), a laboratory score summing the grades of anaemia, thrombocytopenia and leukopenia plus leukocytosis and pancytopenia; it is a clinicopathological, not a clinical, severity grade. Extracted: every Spearman correlation with HES printed in Table 3 (12 markers; Table 3 shows all columns, including the weak ALT and globulin correlations) and the HES comparisons by travel/import history and by antibody serostatus. Not extracted: correlations with HES of urea, creatinine, albumin, GLDH, triglycerides, lipase and the haematology variables are only in Additional file 2 (not in the text). Correlations among non-HES markers (e.g. CRP vs parasitaemia, antibodies vs parasitaemia, albumin vs total protein) and comparisons of CRP, antibody levels and parasitaemia between travel-history or serostatus groups were not extracted, because neither variable is a severity measure. Haematocrit, WBC and platelet count make up the HES but no correlation of them with HES is reported in the text. No infected-vs-healthy comparisons (no control group).

severity_definitions.label: hematological score (HES)
severity_definitions.definition: Haematological score: sum of the grades of anaemia (HCT mild 0.31–0.43, moderate 0.20–0.30, marked < 0.20 l/l), thrombocytopenia (91–149, 40–90, < 40 G/l) and leukopenia (4.0–5.9, 2.0–3.9, < 2.0 G/l) scored 0/+1/+2/+3, plus leukocytosis > 12.0 G/l (+1) and pancytopenia (+3); range 0–11. Higher = more severe haematological abnormality. Used as a continuous severity measure (Spearman) and compared between groups (Mann-Whitney, Kruskal-Wallis).
severity_definitions.quote: A hematological score (HES) was calculated by summing the severities of each cytopenia (0 = not present, + 1 = mild, + 2 = moderate, + 3 = marked) as well as the presence of leukocytosis (> 12.0 G/l, 0 = not present, + 1 = present), and pancytopenia (0 = not present, + 3 = present).

associations.marker_as_reported: history of stays abroad: no stays abroad (autochthonous) vs imported
associations.statistic: HES median 6 (range 1–11, SD 2.5; n = 113, no stays abroad) vs median 2 (range 0–11, SD 3.2; n = 55, imported); Mann-Whitney U = 2774.50, Z = −4.38; Kruskal-Wallis pairwise with Bonferroni H = −43.16, P < 0.001
associations.quote: The HES ranged from 0 – 11 (median: 5), with higher values in dogs without stays abroad/travel to other countries (n = 113, range: 1—11, median: 6, SD: 2.5) respectively, compared with imported dogs (n = 55, range: 0—11, median: 2, SD: 3.2) (U = 2774.50, Z = −4.38, P < 0.001)
associations.location: Results, Hematological, biochemical, and CRP analyses, para 1; Fig. 1
associations.note: Exposure is the dog's travel/import history, outcome is the HES (S1). positive_association = no history of stays abroad goes with a higher HES. The Bonferroni pairwise statistic (H = −43.16, P < 0.001) is in the next sentence of the same paragraph. Proposed new marker name (no canonical fit).

associations.marker_as_reported: history of stays abroad: traveled vs imported
associations.statistic: HES median 5 (range 2–10, SD 2.2; n = 23, traveled) vs median 2 (n = 55, imported); Kruskal-Wallis pairwise with Bonferroni H = −26.38, df = 2
associations.quote: No statistically significant impact was observed when comparing traveled dogs (n = 23, range: 2 – 10, median: 5, SD: 2.2) to imported dogs (H = −26.38, df = 2, P = 0.158)
associations.location: Results, Hematological, biochemical, and CRP analyses, para 1
associations.note: positive_association = traveled dogs (infected after travel, not imported) had the higher median HES; not significant. Proposed new marker name.

associations.quote: and dogs without stays abroad/travel to other countries (H = -16.77, df = 2, P = 0.544)
associations.location: Results, Hematological, biochemical, and CRP analyses, para 1

associations.marker_as_reported: history of stays abroad (no stays abroad / traveled / imported), three groups
associations.statistic: Kruskal-Wallis with Bonferroni correction H = 22.93, df = 2 (no stays abroad n = 113, traveled n = 23, imported n = 55)
associations.quote: in 191 dogs with acute Babesia canis infection in Germany and known history regarding stays abroad (Kruskal–Wallis-test including Bonferroni correction H = 22.93, df = 2, P < 0.001)
associations.note: Overall three-group test; groups are unordered, so direction is mixed (highest HES in dogs without stays abroad, lowest in imported dogs). Proposed new marker name.
